sentences.text: For Respondent(s) : Mr. Manvendra Singh Shekhawat, PP with Mr. Rishi Raj Singh Rathore, PP HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SAMEER JAIN Order 17/09/2024

The present petition filed for quashing of proceedings of criminal case No.82/2014 subjudice before Special Judge-cum- Chief Judicial Magistrate (P.C.P.N.D.T. Act Cases), Ajmer against the complaint for offences under Section 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.

entities.text: Special Judge-cum- Chief Judicial Magistrate (P.C.P.N.D.T. Act Cases), Ajmer
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Upon perusal of the Court file, it is noted that the instant dispute is pending from a prolonged period, approximately 11 years.

Moreover, considering Annexure 2 i.e. the order-sheets qua the instant dispute pending before the learned trial Court, it can be deduced that adjournments are granted without any reasonable justification being noted.

[2024:RJ-JP:39042] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-5445/2024] Considering the aforementioned, as it is a dubious fact as to who has caused the unwarranted delay in the efficacious disposal of the instant dispute, this Court directs the Special Judge-cum- Chief Judicial Magistrate, (P.C.P.N.D.T. Act Cases), Ajmer to adjudicate the matter subjudice before it expeditiously.
Registrar (Judicial) is directed to send a copy of this order to the concerned District Judge.
Reasonable explanation qua the unwarranted delay in the instant dispute be furnished.
Accordingly, the instant petition is disposed of.
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
